note: Per-cell element ledger derived from HGSS land_data. lab: T rock (faces from terrace levels), C rock climb, F tree (tree: its 2x2 block), O boulder, R sea rock, X building or prop, f fence, q quay rail, B blocked plain ground, ~ water, . open. floor: ground under the cell. terrace: level above the town floor (under trees, the ground they stand on).
